# Source and local modifications

- Upstream: https://github.com/Supreeeme/xrizer, commit `0989a7fac2d1efb7ea82f5fe1a8ed30c3eeb9596`, GPL-3.0-or-later. Its LICENSE and bundled notices are retained in `upstream/`.
- Unmodified source verification: SHA-256 `0093b9e049460f0ff234d798c6b416693b8b0e965206f315af2ea04b451b31f3` of the byte stream generated by `git archive --format=tar 0989a7fac2d1efb7ea82f5fe1a8ed30c3eeb9596`. This is a Git-generated tar stream hash, not a GitHub download hash.
- `apple-port.patch` records all modifications inside `upstream/`, relative to that commit. SHA-256 `08f3383a48c2ff085ba98d67bd821da038ba783aa66cac143e6cb88c50985957`.
- Eighteen files changed: staticlib and Apple platform build metadata; Apple gating for GLX, Linux desktop error UI and Vulkan overlay shader generation; an explicit Apple initialization error until a real native provider is implemented; an isolated OpenXR Metal Graphics binding with mock dispatch test, and an isolated Metal host copy bridge with mock resource-lifetime tests. A Metal backend and explicit provider registration support an owned-test route; the ordinary Apple initialization remains unavailable. A native xrizer frontend stereo fixture has passed with injected host state; Windows guest ABI, physical headset and actual game remain unverified. No AVP Play patches applied.
- String scan of upstream finds no ReactOS references. Wine is named in `src/openxr_data.rs` process-name detection; OpenComposite is credited in the README and cited in `src/misc_unknown.rs`, `src/compositor.rs`, and `src/system.rs`. This text scan does not establish full source or transitive dependency provenance; review remains necessary against project rules.

- Legacy setup propagates profile path, suggestion, attach and sync errors; its profile binding path interning is fallible. Other manifest and restart paths retain upstream limitations. This is not proof that action binding or nonzero pose arrays work.

- Pose-array population now clears entries for absent devices instead of retaining caller-provided stale values. Actual repeat, invalid-tracking, and guest ABI coverage remains pending; count guards were subsequently removed only after the focused owned test below.

- GetLastPoses handles game-only and unequal nonzero counts and rejects null nonzero arrays; legacy GetControllerState propagates input setup failure as false. The focused injected native diagnostic tested these changes only with snapshot guard bypass; ordinary Apple initialization remains unavailable.

- The three owned-apple-test-only pose guards were removed after the focused injected-host proof. Snapshot aZWPby compiled the exact unguarded compositor source and passed four changing valid/invalid HMD calls, no stale absent controllers, System019 role and pose API controls, and balanced cancellation. Normal no-feature Mac build still reports AppleBackendUnavailable (owned smoke test). Guest AOT, headset and game remain unverified.

- Controller-with-pose, haptic, event-pose and System device-pose array paths now avoid panic on missing input/device or null pointer and clear absent pose slots. Owned focused native snapshot Un4dP4 tested disconnected controller/haptic and device-pose/null controls; actual connected controllers remain unsupported.

- The owned Apple route requires a private, versioned native provider static-optics query during initialization. It uses host-provided VIEW-relative eye poses and FOV before the first frame, and switches to timed provider views after a real wait. Missing or invalid metadata fails initialization. This query does not imply a tracked head, frame, clock, or standard OpenXR extension; the ordinary Apple route remains fail-closed.

- Apple `GetDXGIOutputInfo` writes the pinned OpenVR header’s error sentinel -1 when no verified guest adapter mapping exists, and safely ignores a null output. It does not claim an adapter index or change other platforms. Owned native snapshot `dkziw5` exercised the actual System019 slot before the first wait, with output guards and null, exit 0. Manifest SHA-256 `c0d085f9ae297a93647595bb921de679baeebb6c26f631e343b4d424bd7486c2`, fixture-substitution record `94cd04d865ecf8bf6e7a45f603735ac22dd3c2d17ba9966792db76996568ca41`, log `38822f3a06b8b55da3e161152856486fd3171d65220eb9f26fb81b1fa5170a1c`, dylib `71aed9176b0f201072385a5f7bb43672fe23f27cd140cb6e0660d35a5df4211e`. This is native injected-host evidence, not Windows guest or game evidence.

- Apple no-render frames no longer acquire a fresh swapchain image; existing outstanding-image drain remains unchanged and a no-render Submit returns RequestFailed. The owned actual native xrizer/experimental xros-host macOS fixture `xFA4vt` passed two real offscreen Metal eye pairs with pixel, ID and lease checks, then two no-render Wait/Begin/zero-layer End cycles without new image acquisition and with clean cancellation/drain, exit 0. It uses injected optics, lifecycle, local tracking and native source tokens. Fixture manifest SHA-256 `6924c4bdcd09fc57d26f35d699f6ede44f52ba28997014191619789cc5fb8a22`, executable `ae8899c9fa3cef23980b6b3b95fd260f97665a7d1f11fec2d3d1fcf7a170abdd`, log `4c09db27a171b98b71ba55ddeec0b29aee58ea9ef935637ad78a9d704298d7ee`, dylib `dcf751cdd564922cb163f4e6323f9baddf99bcbbf58c72911abe5727db719baa`. Dylib source snapshot `V1DUww` manifest `90263ad48300a8ed8590bba743d00259bd2a74b790ec2693ced05ea76dda5d09`; its fixture substitution record `94cd04d865ecf8bf6e7a45f603735ac22dd3c2d17ba9966792db76996568ca41` does not change Rust source. This does not establish Windows guest, D3D source, real tracking, simulator or headset behavior.

- Optional `make -C VXRuntime xros-xrizer-static-probe` builds an isolated owned-apple-test xrizer static archive plus real Klepton and xros-host adapter into an arm64 visionOS simulator link-only executable. The SDK 26.1/minimum 26.0 build passed and symbol inspection found the native factory, configuration callbacks, adapter registration and provider dispatch. Archive SHA-256 `deb7fc0b3be12e98975b1b70370ede86621b7fe3c219c126524b1dc274dd6bd1`, executable `0d995390f732c38faf986670e625346e7ea41b79df6524c1ebcea496a3cac6bf`, input manifest `a70d9c8d672007345bf4f7f939ac25a3ec0cb38f915bcaef20b8efab8d67f3d5`. It does not run a simulator, guest, GPU or headset and does not enable the default app.

- Apple frame-path diagnostics in `upstream/src/compositor.rs`: `warn!` on every previously silent failure return in `PostPresentHandoff`, `end_frame` (view flags, `xrEndFrame` error), `wait_frame`, `begin_frame`, `maybe_wait_frame` and `maybe_begin_frame`, and in `WaitGetPoses`. No behaviour change. Together with the earlier Gamma/Auto UNORM acceptance in `graphics_backends/metal.rs`, this means `apple-port.patch` (hash above) has not been regenerated and no longer matches `upstream/`; regenerate it before relying on that hash. Verified by owned `cargo test graphics_backends::metal` (1 passed) and the actual-game probes recorded in the continuation plan. Not a game compatibility claim.
- Apple cleanup accepts a previously observed `STOPPING` state after host surface loss, instead of requiring the same event to be delivered twice. Owned simulator offscreen snapshot `UjBVTn` passed its injected-loss control after the guest observed STOPPING; it drained with 12/12 source leases, 1/1/1 lifecycle acknowledgments, and refused resumption, while 46 AOT entries and zero fallback were reported. This does not prove a real OS pause or physical headset. Runtime log SHA-256 `5ecbfebee69b7a8ae3533972fcfe91be465d48bdc546548f358b7eac64949878`; simulator static archive `7ccff73f6b51c962466b823b05daa4fe23ae0949ba769e5dd8fe5a95254a26bf`.

- Local fix (2026-11-10), `refresh-rate-fallback.patch` (applies on top of `apple-port.patch`, to `upstream/src/openxr_data.rs`, SHA-256 `61384856143f40ddbd9291dc3fb3155891eb33f8e3323ff2173eb07af3c0c147`; already applied in `upstream/`): `get_refresh_rate`'s fallback (used when `XR_FB_display_refresh_rate` is not enabled, as with the Klepton provider, which does not advertise it) returned the display period in seconds (about 0.0111) instead of the rate. It now returns `1.0 / period` Hz, 0.0 for a zero period. The same code is in the pinned upstream commit `0989a7f` (the Apple port patch does not touch it); upstream's current head was not checked (no network access authorized). The value fed `Prop_DisplayFrequency_Float` and `m_flClientFrameIntervalMs` (1000 / rate). The Rust dylib was not rebuilt or run here.
- Local fix (2026-11-10), `render-target-size-fallback.patch` (diff of `upstream/src/system.rs`, SHA-256 `133885f03213b51874fefe6b3f44296055afda5bf6d9213f770852eef28921ca`; already applied in `upstream/`): `IVRSystem::GetRecommendedRenderTargetSize` unwrapped `enumerate_view_configuration_views`. When the Klepton provider has no compositor surface (the system ended the immersive space) it answers `XR_ERROR_FORM_FACTOR_UNAVAILABLE`, and the unwrap aborted the process mid-game (device run 6, SIGABRT). It now remembers the last good size and returns it with a `warn!`. Other unwraps on that path were read: `system.rs:91` (a two-element Vec to array, cannot fail) and the visibility-mask getter at about line 447 (`get_visibility_mask_khr(...).unwrap()`) was NOT changed; it panics if the provider lacks that extension and the game asks for a hidden-area mesh. The Rust archives were rebuilt for the device and simulator link probes; not run on a game.
